detailed_descriptions.en: 4 Additional brawlers join Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2! Grab all 4 of these additional brawlers at a great value and receive a bonus SpongeBob Squarepants “The Quickster” costume to best your foes in style. This season pass features: - 4 additional brawlers - Bonus SpongeBob Squarepants "The Quickster" Costume Note: Brawlers contained in this pack are also sold separately and released throughout 2024. In order to use this downloadable content, you will need Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 (sold separately).
